Despina Papamichail ( Greek : Δέσποινα Παπαμιχαήλ ; born 9 February 1993) is a Greek professional tennis player. She has a career-high singles ranking of world No. 143, reached on 20 June 2022. Her highest doubles ranking is No. 93, achieved on 4 December 2023.
Papamichail has won two doubles titles on the WTA Challenger Tour as well as 17 singles and 39 doubles titles on the ITF Women's Circuit . Playing for the Greece Fed Cup team , Papamichail has a win–loss record of 31–29 (as of May 2024). Career [ edit ] Papamichail made her WTA Tour main-draw debut as a lucky loser at the 2021 Abu Dhabi Open , losing to third seed Karolína Plíšková in the first round. [ 1 ] In June 2021, she won the inaugural $60k Charleston Pro event by defeating Gabriela Cé in the final. [ 2 ] She was selected to play for Greece at the 2023 United Cup , recording a win over Isabella Shinikova . [ 3 ] Papamichail qualified for the 2023 Pan Pacific Open and defeated lucky loser Sakura Hosogi , [ 4 ] before going out in the second round against sixth seed Daria Kasatkina .
